global.headline: Google launches Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with 15-second video generation
global.source_title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
global.summary: Google made Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available through the Gemini API and Gemini for business, adding native video creation up to 15 seconds and conversational editing. Google says 720p generation now costs $0.07 per second, a 30% reduction from Omni 1.1.

global.headline: METR estimates faster Anthropic model progress, with substantial uncertainty
global.source_title: Anthropic's models improving nearly twice as fast with help from AI, study finds
global.summary: METR estimates Anthropic's benchmark capabilities have improved about 1.9 times faster since October 2025 as AI contributes to development. The assessment carries high uncertainty and says AI cannot yet make major, fully autonomous contributions to the most important training stages.

india.headline: Quess reports rising share of AI, data and security hiring in India's GCCs
india.source_title: AI, data, cybersecurity lead tech hiring with 30.3% share in September quarter
india.summary: A Quess report puts AI, data and cybersecurity at 30.3% of Indian global capability centres' technology hiring demand in July–September, up from 25.8% in the preceding quarter. It reports approximately 14% growth in demand for AI, data and analytics professionals, even as overall GCC tech hiring demand fell 3.5%.
